scope: Scoped agent inspection of six complete current EXE frames: Asian overview, regional and selected formation views in both desktop layouts, plus detailed Shanhaiguan. The listed frames were actually opened. Not formal art, historical or physical-phone acceptance.
observations: Individual formation counters remain separate, while selection restores the complete unit and its movement range in both layouts.

Grass/soil now continues beneath roads, city areas and the Shanhaiguan coast. The plain no longer carries the earlier large orange fallen-leaf pattern. The translucent control wash retains visible ground.

The Asian map retains coarse hexagonal ground/control footprints, displaced city labels and placed mountain miniatures. The close Shanhaiguan frame has crowded formations, and the selected historical commander still has a blank portrait panel. These issues are not signed off as commercial art parity.
